content:
**History view: git/tag facts, merged events, Reviews-mode link (#882 PR 4)**

Added the History governance sub-view (R882-5), PR 4 of 5 in the #882
chain. status/history.mjs's gatherHistoryFacts reads git log (commit sha,
date, subject, a trailing (#N) PR suffix) and git tags through the same
injected _run seam release-debt.mjs already uses; either read failing is
the whole section's own {ok:false, reason}. snapshot.mjs wires history in
additively, beside the nine existing sections. lib/history-model.mjs's
buildHistoryModel merges three event kinds newest-first through
governance-model.mjs's shared row() helper: a merge event per commit
(sourced to the forge PR URL when the served project and a PR number are
both known, to git otherwise — never a fabricated link from one alone), a
release event per tag, and an adr-amended event per dated ADR amendment.
Review verdicts are deliberately excluded: no field anywhere in the data
carries a review round's timestamp (prReviews returns {state, author,
body} only), so app.js's renderHistory links to the existing Reviews mode
instead of rendering a second, undated projection of the same rounds.
No score or ranking anywhere in this view (issue #882's own guard) — a
plain event count sits beside the list it counts.

Deviation from the apply prompt's stated reuse target: no lib/forge-url.mjs
or exported prUrl(project, number) helper exists anywhere in this
codebase (verified by full-repo search) — the nearest precedent is
change-route.mjs's own private, unexported buildPrUrl(project, pr), which
is a SERVER-side Node module (imports node:fs/node:child_process) and
cannot be imported into browser-side app.js. state.meta?.project IS real
(server.mjs's buildMeta() -> sent on the 'sync' SSE frame -> merged into
state.meta by frames.mjs's applyFrame), matching the prompt's other claim
correctly. buildHistoryModel's signature was extended from design.md's
literal {history, adrs} to {history, adrs, project} (project optional,
defaulting to null) because provenance.mjs's sourceStamp requires a full
https://.../pull/N URL to render the [forge: #N] label spec.md's own
scenario demands — a bare prNumber cannot produce that label. This keeps
the URL-building pure and inside the declared file list (history-model.mjs
was already an allowed PR 4 file); no new file was added, change-route.mjs
was not touched, and governance-model.mjs's stale History placeholder text
was left untouched, following PR 2/PR 3's own established precedent for
that same table.

Counted diff 222 (plan estimate ~380, budget 1000). Full suite
5899 pass / 0 fail (baseline after PR 3: 5879 pass / 0 fail).
